Nike's capital expenditures (additions to property, plant and equipment) fell about 33.3% from fiscal Q1 2026 to fiscal Q4 2026.

- **Q1 FY2026** (three months ended August 31, 2025): $207 million, from the prior-year column of the Q1 FY2027 10-Q.
- **Q4 FY2026:** the filings give no standalone figure, so I derived it. Full-year FY2026 capex was $684 million and the nine months ended February 28, 2026 was $546 million, so Q4 = 684 − 546 = $138 million.
- **Change:** (138 − 207) / 207 = −33.3%.
